title: Deliver dev.6 Machine Gate
goal: Ship one pinned, bounded, exact-process machine Gate that rejects bad evidence and unlocks repair without weakening Assignment safety.

prompt.objective: Add known-red contract tests for CheckSpec registration, pinned Gate transitions, stale execution tokens, bounded public evidence, and failure routing.
instructions: Test only public Core or CLI contracts.
Prove invalid CheckSpec and missing revisions fail before Run mutation.
Keep output classification and digest separate from bounded local bytes.
doneWhen: Valid and invalid CheckSpec revisions have stable expected results.
Known-bad, stale-token, duplicate-claim, blocked-spawn, and route cases fail against dev.5 for the intended reason.
Tests assert no shell string, environment value, or raw output reaches public events.
forbidden: Do not implement the candidate while defining the red contract.

prompt.objective: Build the smallest PoC proving exact argv execution, bounded capture, timeout through the held child handle, and sentinel survival.
instructions: Capture the exact process handle directly; never search by PID or name.
Record what an uncatchable host kill cannot guarantee.
doneWhen: A timed-out child stops while an independent sentinel remains alive.
No shell or broad process command appears in the PoC.
Output and elapsed time are bounded and reproducible.
forbidden: Do not signal a process not created by this PoC.
Do not reuse a browser or terminal process.

nodes.title: Implement Check Registry and Gate Runner

prompt.objective: Implement immutable CheckSpec revisions, two-phase Gate execution, exact-process Runner, resource ownership, bounded evidence, and CLI authoring/inspection.
instructions: Keep process execution outside every SQLite transaction.
Persist an opaque execution identity and accept only its current token.
Treat configuration and spawn failures as Blocked; only exit or timeout selects fail.
Create cohesive Gate modules instead of expanding the Core service monolith.
doneWhen: Check validate/apply/list/show use stable JSON envelopes.
Eligible Gate work claims once, runs exact argv without a shell, and reports through one opaque execution handle.
Pass, fail, Blocked, timeout, stale output, cancellation, and reconciliation satisfy focused tests.
Progressive Help and bounded inspection expose recovery without raw command output.
forbidden: No shell invocation or command interpolation.
No inherited environment except declared names.
No broad process lookup or unowned signal.
No raw Check output in events, Assignments, Viewer, render, or Evidence.

prompt.objective: Exercise Gate success, known-bad repair, timeout, missing executable, stale execution, cancellation, resource release, package behavior, and public evidence bounds.
instructions: Run real child processes only from test-owned fixtures.
Include one sentinel and one stale-token control.
Verify source CLI before isolated-package replay.
doneWhen: The bad fixture cannot reach End and returns one repair Assignment.
The fixed fixture passes the same pinned Check revision.
Timeout stops only the exact child and sentinel survival is observed.
No duplicate accepted execution, leaked resource, secret, or unbounded output remains.
forbidden: Do not weaken assertions to pass.
Do not inspect or stop unrelated user processes.

prompt.objective: Select pass only when UP07 and every Gate-owned S06 clause pass with exact process, persistence, security, recovery, and package evidence.
instructions: Choose repair for any shell, path, environment, process-owner, stale-token, duplicate-work, output-bound, or package blocker.
Cite exact commands and known-bad controls.
doneWhen: All Gate contract, source, installed-package, timeout, sentinel, and recovery Gates pass.
No unresolved blocker or unaccepted debt remains.
forbidden: Do not route pass from a partial or source-only verification.
